description: Escape text into HTML entities and decode entities back to text, both directions done correctly.

faqs.a: Encode escapes &, <, >, " and ' and converts common Latin-1 characters (like é and ©) to named entities. Decoding reverses all of it.
Yes. Decoding uses the browser's own HTML parser, so every named, decimal and hexadecimal entity is handled.
faqs.q: Does decoding handle numeric entities like é?

faqs.a: Yes — decoding “&lt;” gives “<”, not “<”. Each pass decodes exactly one level.
faqs.q: Is double-encoded text decoded one level at a time?

howto: Choose Encode or Decode at the top.
Type or paste your text — conversion happens live.
Switch modes any time; the text converts in place.
Copy the result with one click.
